messages.content: Connect to the MUD, Look at your surroundings, check your score, then look at the available exits and tell me what you see.

text:
I’ll do those MUD commands in sequence and report back.
I’m not able to directly connect to the MUD from here because no MUD connection tool is available in this session.

If you paste the output of these commands, I can interpret it for you:

- `look`
- `score`
- `exits` or `look exits` if your MUD supports it

If you want, I can also help you with the exact command sequence to type in your MUD client.
